description: Comment threads on the presentation file (served by the Drive API internally — scoped to this one file, no generic Drive access). action=list returns comments with replies and resolved status (pageSize/page_token to paginate, include_deleted for tombstones); get needs comment_id; create needs content and starts a new unanchored thread (the API cannot anchor a new comment to a specific slide or shape); reply needs comment_id + content and/or resolve=true (resolve closes the thread); delete needs comment_id and permanently removes the thread with all replies. Requires a Drive scope on the OAuth token (https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive) — a presentations-only token gets a 403 here.

action.description: What to do with the presentation's comments.

comment_id.description: get/reply/delete: the comment id from list.

include_deleted.description: list: include deleted comments as tombstones.

page_token.description: list: nextPageToken from the previous page.

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

resolve.description: reply only: also mark the whole thread resolved.

name: manage_comments
title: Manage comments
